channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: CNN left off Air Force One for Trump's upcoming trip, White House signals in new media restriction
item.description: The White House has signaled that CNN will be left off Air Force One for President Donald Trump's Saturday trip in the latest media restriction in an ongoing dispute with First Amendment implications.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
item.description: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterms for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primaries.

item.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
item.description: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

item.title: Takeaways from the Trump-Xi state visit: Pageantry and pandas
item.description: The visit comes at an important time for both men.

item.title: Trump’s Greenland deal shadows Xi visit after years of Beijing eyeing Arctic influence
item.description: Trump's Greenland security deal blocked China's Arctic ambitions days before Xi Jinping arrived for a state dinner with America's top AI executives.

item.title: How a six pack of beer and the Magna Carta could finally fix a problem plaguing Americans for decades
item.description: Kenneth Jouppi's $95,000 Cessna was seized over a misdemeanor beer conviction, and the Supreme Court will now weigh Eighth Amendment limits.

item.title: Kamala Harris uses flower analogy to explain social media algorithms while discussing AI, midterms
item.description: Former Vice President Kamala Harris used an odd analogy involving pink and yellow flowers to explain how social media algorithms target users during a recent podcast appearance.

item.title: St Paul police chief sues mayor, alleging she called herself a 'MILF,' sexually harassed him and retaliated
item.description: Axel Henry's 73-page lawsuit accuses St. Paul Mayor Kaohly Her of explicit sexual comments, unwanted physical contact and a retaliation campaign.

item.title: Family of paralyzed Marine vet allegedly shot by migrant speaks out as health issue could delay testimony
item.description: Jimmy Friesenhahn, a Marine veteran paralyzed in a San Antonio shooting, faces a health crisis before trial, his family told Fox News Digital.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri from using new congressional map in 2026 election
item.description: The Supreme Court ordered Missouri Friday to use its 2022 congressional map for the 2026 election, blocking use of the state's newer 2025 map.

item.title: Police search a house filled with porn for clues about missing women
item.description: A Philadelphia man created a vast trove of degrading images of women, police say. At least five may have been dead when they were photographed or recorded.

item.title: More states weigh pausing gas taxes before Election Day as diesel prices spike
item.description: Since the Iran war sent gas prices soaring, Georgia, Kentucky and Indiana have cut or suspended their gas taxes. Similar proposals are under consideration in Ohio and Massachusetts.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri congressional map favoring GOP for third time
item.description: The ruling ends a complicated legal fight that has injected uncertainty into November’s midterm elections in the state.

item.title: Utah university releases independent review of Charlie Kirk shooting
item.description: The school commissioned the independent review after a gunman shot Charlie Kirk as he addressed a crowd on Sept. 10, 2025.

item.title: Ranchers accuse Trump administration of disrupting beef supply, as prices rise
item.description: Industry groups warned that ICE sweeps are “having a massive chilling effect on the legal, documented, skilled workers that put beef on the table.”

item.title: Hurricane Polo tracker: Map and projected storm path
item.description: Polo is the 18th named storm of the hurricane season.

item.title: Government can use Social Security data to identify noncitizen voters, Supreme Court rules
item.description: President Donald Trump wants to let states use a federal database that includes voters’ personal information to check for noncitizens on voter rolls.

item.title: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson criticizes Supreme Court’s use of emergency docket
item.description: In a public appearance, Jackson said the high court’s use of the emergency docket was “problematic” and called for more restraint from her colleagues when using it.

item.title: Trump administration asks Supreme Court to allow ‘third country’ deportations for now
item.description: A lower court blocked the policy, which has sent thousands of migrants to countries where they are not citizens.

item.title: Trump heads to Texas-Tennessee football game as midterm rallies slide
item.description: Trump will attend the Tennessee-Texas college football game on Saturday and the President’s Cup golf tournament on Sunday.
